title: Improve your list
subtitle: Suggested programs
methodBody: Suggestions combine similarity to the current list, approximate proximity, historical demand, estimated admission access and diversity between recommendations.
submit: Add selected programs and review my list

address.label: Your home address
address.help: Optional. Without it, distance is measured from your current list.
address.changed: Address changed. Click the button to update the coordinates.
address.confirmed: Distances will be computed from the confirmed address: {address}
address.privacyBody: The address is sent to OpenStreetMap/Nominatim only after you click the geocoding button. Distances remain approximate and do not represent travel time.

precision.approximate: The geocoded location is approximate. Distances should be interpreted carefully.
precision.city: The geocoder could only identify the city or municipality. Distances are approximate.

distance.noHardFilter: Because the home location is only city-level or approximate, no hard distance cutoff is applied. Straight-line distance only affects the recommendation score.
distance.hardLimit: The {maxDistance} km straight-line limit is applied only when the program has reliable school-level coordinates. Commune and regional approximations are never used for hard exclusion.

count.question: How many recommendations do you want?

filters.title: Narrow the suggestions — optional
filters.intro: The same filters as the search page. Set any of them and the suggestions below update to match.

card.add: Add this program to the end of my list
card.chanceAppended: Chance of getting in as your preference #{rank}
card.chanceNote: If you add this one to the end of your current list.

empty.needWishes: Enter at least one valid program in the wish list to get recommendations.
empty.noSimilar: No similar program was found under the current proximity/scoring rules.
empty.noneMatched: No recommended program matched the current scoring and reliable straight-line distance rules. You can still add programs manually.
empty.allAlreadyAdded: All selected recommendations are already in the wish list.

warning.similarityFallback: The current list does not contain enough usable information to infer clear similar-program preferences. The suggestions below are therefore based mainly on distance and estimated admission safety.
warning.failedCandidates: Some programs could not be evaluated because of invalid source data, and no recommendation was produced.
warning.limitedByFilters: These are all the suggestions that match your filters. Widen the filters to see more.
